svg.aria-label: How the gate runs. Your repository's check command, also run before a push, calls semgrep. Semgrep loads the registry packs for your languages and this repository's rules file pinned to a tag. It takes the merge base with origin/main as the baseline, so only findings the branch adds count. With --error, any new WARNING or ERROR fails the check.
